Save audio to WAV file

Source: R/wav.R
save_wav.Rd

Helper function to write stereo audio to a WAV file.

Usage

save_wav(samples, path, rate = 44100L)

Arguments

samples

A matrix of double values. Values need to be between -1 and +1. The matrix needs to have 2 rows. One for each channel.

path

Path of the file where the audio needs to be stored

rate

Sample rate. Defaults to 44100L

Value

Nothing
